name: Scheme for Fencing in Gardens
benefit: The scheme provides financial support for fencing gardens to protect fruit plants, horticultural crops, and orchards from wild animals, offering a subsidy of 50% of the total cost, up to a maximum of ₹1.00 lakh per hectare.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card.
